topic: sub:11|Graph transformations|Establish reflections in the x- and y-axes

parts.latex: Write down the equation of the transformed function obtained when the graph of $f(x) = x^2 - 5x + 1$ is reflected in the $y$-axis?

solutions.latex:
Reflection in the $y$-axis replaces $x$ with $-x$.

$$\begin{aligned} f(-x) &= (-x)^2 - 5(-x) + 1 \\ &= x^2 + 5x + 1 \end{aligned}$$
